newsitem.title: USA: US June S&P 500 ends down in brisk post-FOMC trade.
newsitem.headline: US June S&P 500 ends down in brisk post-FOMC trade.

text.p: March 25 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures ended lower in heavy trading after the Fed raised its fed funds target to 5.50 pct from 5.25 pct. Traders said idea was this tightening likely the first in a cycle. Traders put support at 793.00 and 788.40, say consolidation or choppy sideways trade likely Wednesday as players sort out their positions after today's wild ride. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/))
